paperInfo.subject: English Literature
paperInfo.curriculum: ZIMSEC Advanced Level / Heritage-Based Curriculum-aligned practice
paperInfo.copyrightNote: Original practice questions synthesized from syllabus and examination structure; not verbatim copies of copyrighted past papers.
paperInfo.sourceBasis: ZIMSEC syllabus/specimen resources and publicly accessible examination-pattern references.

questions.questionText: Literature in English: Poetry analysis. Discuss how a writer can use this technique or concern to shape meaning in a literary text. Refer to precise textual evidence, analyse language/form/structure, and evaluate how context and alternative interpretations may affect a reader's response.
questions.explanation: A strong A-Level response should present a clear argument, use relevant textual evidence, analyse rather than merely describe, and consider context and alternative readings.
